name: Connect then message
description: The shortest respectable sequence: an invite with a note, one message on acceptance, one polite close. Four touches total. Use it when you have volume and no time.
audience: A cold list where the value proposition does the work and personalisation beyond first name and company is not realistic.

variants: Hi {{firstName|there}} — I work with {{title|people in your role}} on the same problem you're likely sitting on at {{company|your company}}. Worth being connected either way.
{{firstName|Hi}} — connecting because I spend my week with {{title|people doing your job}} and yours is a company I keep hearing about. No agenda.
Thanks for connecting, {{firstName|there}}. Quick context: I help {{title|teams like yours}} cut the manual half of this work. Is that even on your list at {{company|your company}} right now?
Good to be connected, {{firstName|there}}. I'll be direct — is the manual side of this still eating your team's week at {{company|your company}}, or have you solved it?
Reading the silence as a no for now, {{firstName|there}} — completely fair. I'll leave it there. Shout if the picture changes at {{company|your company}}.
I'll stop here, {{firstName|there}}. If this becomes a real problem at {{company|your company}} later, my inbox is open.
